promotions.title: Order 10+ Corporate Boxes, Get Free Custom Ribbon Branding
promotions.description: Corporate catering orders of 10 or more boxed meals placed for September or October ship with complimentary custom ribbon branding at no extra cost.

promotions.title: 10% Off Your First Wedding Catering Order
promotions.description: First-time wedding clients get 10% off any full wedding boxed meal order placed at least 30 days before the event date.

promotions.description: Reserve limited-edition holiday boxed meals — seasonal cheeses, preserves, and champagne truffles — before they sell out.

private.name: Celebration Charcuterie Collection
